ANSUR_RAD_STYL_context_mm.definition: Most proximal lateral radial-head landmark to distal radial styloid surface landmark; ANSUR surface measurement, not automatic articular-centre chord.

blockers: Map RAD surface landmark to proximal radius articular/head centre in source-compatible geometry.
Map STYL tip to distal radius articular centre and separately to the chosen wrist centre.
Independent endpoint-compatible stature context and PRUJ/DRUJ contact solve.

ulna.policy: Do not infer a lengthening amount or a fixed radius ratio.
blockers: Separate olecranon tip, trochlear-notch reference and coronoid base.
Separate distal ulnar head/contact centre from ulnar styloid tip and radial wrist centre.
Resolve independent ulna dimensions/variance and proximal/distal contact congruence.

joint_span_context.interpretation: These values use different wrist definitions. Agreement in directional shortness is not an endpoint-matched numerical target.

mechanical_invariants: Keep PRUJ, DRUJ and separate radius/ulna identities.
Pronation-supination reference passes between proximal radial-head and distal ulnar-head/contact references; it is not automatically either bone’s head-tail line.
Whole-bone ulna length and EJC-WJC span are different dimensions.
next_safe_action: Acquire matched radial/ulnar articular and surface landmarks, then solve radius, ulna, DRUJ and wrist together with independently selected bone dimensions. Keep production/a003 unchanged.
